facts.event: Tilde 任由侍女 Hadiah 清点打包她的珠宝与膏药，准备在婚约刚签时便启程赴敌国宫廷行刺。
facts.relation: Hadiah 是 Tilde 的侍女，替她掌管行装
facts.anchor: Hadiah oversaw the collecting of my things, my jewels, my ointments

facts.event: Cynghal 统治者禁止 Merogians 进入 kithwood 祖林，违令的 tarns 与国王被处死或鞭刑，穷人被割去肢体。
facts.numbers: punishable by death or flogging for the tarns and kings, mutilation for the poor
facts.anchor: Not to give thanks to our ancestors, not to gather the fruits and fallen branches, not to hunt.

facts.event: Rivani 在弟妹被折磨后打开城门、降下蛇轮旗，向入侵的 Kanaan 与 Falcan 军队屈膝。
facts.relation: Rivani 是 Tilde 的母亲，也是 Ardwen 的末代国王
facts.anchor: the last king of Ardwen bent her knee to the raider’s armies.

facts.event: Colfinn 与 Ebba 被钉在城门外囚车的枷柱上示众受刑，Tilde 连续五天只盼他们早死。
facts.relation: Colfinn 与 Ebba 是 Tilde 的兄弟姐妹
facts.anchor: I spent five days wishing for their deaths.

facts.event: Rivani 当面质问 Tilde 是否给过 Hadiah 选择，拆穿她借和亲赴死、并未替随从留活路的打算。
facts.relation: Hadiah 是 Tilde 的贴身随从，出身双血统王族
facts.anchor: ‘Warriors choose their fate; have you given Hadiah that choice?’

facts.event: Tilde 惊觉母亲真正的意思是让她为天鹅王生下一个孩子，用这血脉把孩子做成敌国宫廷的人质与纽带。
facts.relation: Rivani 要 Tilde 生下 Liran 的孩子
facts.anchor: ‘You want me to bear his child,’ I gasped, letting go.

facts.event: Rivani 指出表亲银女王已六年没有音讯、Torcros 的商路与港口被自毁，Tilde 所指望的两路援军都来不了。
facts.relation: 银女王 Argentha 是 Rivani 的表亲（cousin）
facts.anchor: We have not heard from our cousin in six years.

facts.event: Rivani 临别把一枚蛇形银戒指按进 Tilde 掌心，戒指蓝宝石根部嵌着一根 kithwood 荆棘，触毒会变色。
facts.relation: Rivani 把戒指作为母亲的护身物交给女儿
facts.anchor: It was a thorn, set in the ring, at the base of the stone.
